basic_info.description: Adorable View Home Nestled Atop Excelsior Hill. Located on a private, quiet street, this charming home perfectly blends classic artistic appeal with modern convenience. Follow the front garden pathway to a welcoming formal portico with a cozy seating area. The living and dining rooms offer sweeping city views, while the bedrooms provide peaceful garden and valley vistas. Inside, enjoy an updated, move-in-ready space featuring a sleek, contemporary kitchen, gorgeous hardwood floors, and an airy light-filled environment. Lushly landscaped front and rear gardens offer luxurious outdoor spaces for entertaining or unwinding.    With 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, and a spacious one-car garage, this home is a true city sanctuary. Just steps away from beautiful McLaren Park for daily jogging and adventures, and with quick access to Freeways 101 and 280 for an easy commute, this home offers an unbeatable location. Don't miss this adorable hidden gem!
